verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents per-project alerts that email the project's team members by default, plus extra webhook recipients, and teams exist to route notifications to the right people. That covers only basic project-level routing to email and generic webhooks. Missing for 10: routing by environment or severity, native Slack and PagerDuty integrations (only generic webhooks are evidenced), per-rule thresholds for frequency spikes and affected-user counts, and any independent corroboration.
